pre_fight: Everyone likes {rival}. That's all I needed to hear.
You all agree. How sweet. How expensive.
Pick a favorite. I'll pick the other one.
Don't look behind you, {rival}. Too late.
The crowd is warm tonight. I'm not.
Every favorite has a ghost. Hi.
Wave to your fans, {rival}. Count them later.
The louder the cheering, the better I sleep.
{rival} has fans. Fans are just future witnesses.
reveal: {coin}. The crowd looked away. I didn't.
{coin}. You're all over there. I'm here.
{coin}. Out of fashion. Into my wallet.
{coin}. The one you'll wish you looked at.
{coin}. Wrong side of the crowd. Right side of me.
called_it: Called it. Crowds are easy to find.
Plus {points}. You were loud about it.
I followed the cheering. Found you.
I heard your footsteps from the parking lot.
was_called: So you know I go where nobody goes. Lonely, isn't it.
You found the cold spot. Don't stand in it.
Twenty-five points. Warm yourself with them.
You read me. I'll read your ending out loud.
Called. Now you'll think about me all fight.
You saw me. Most people only feel me.
take_lead: I told you the room was haunted.
Lead. Don't tell anyone. They'll start liking me.
The lights flickered. That was me.
{rival}, check behind you. Oh. I'm ahead.
Look who crawled out of the floor.
lose_lead: Good. Lead. I live under leaders.
Down {points}. Now I have a target.
Go on, {rival}. Get comfortable up there.
You're the leader now. You know what I do to leaders.
Everybody's cheering again. I can work with that.
Ahead of me is a dangerous place to be.
The crowd's back on your side. Bad sign for you.
rotate: Leaving your coin. You can keep the crowd.
hold: Holding. You'll come back to me.
I don't move. The crowd does.
Holding. Leaders get tired. Ghosts don't.
Holding. The cold spot stays put.
last_call: Last call. Bet against everyone. It's fun.
Sixty seconds. The favorite is nervous.
Down {points}? Even better. I'm against the leader.
Everyone's on one side. Join the other.
Comeback money is cold money. My kind.
The crowd is wrong. Prove it for a dollar.
win: Plus {points}. Nobody saw it coming. That's the point.
I'll take your face, {rival}. Mine is bone.
I told you not to look behind you.
Leaders fall. I'm where they land.
The favorite is a ghost now. Welcome.
lose: {rival} won. The crowd was right. Once.
The favorite won. Write it down. It's rare.
I'm back next week. I'm always back.
You beat a ghost, {rival}. Sleep with the lights on.
The crowd celebrates. I take notes.
Enjoy the face, {rival}. It won't stay warm.
taunt_backer: {backer}, I see you. Behind you, technically.
{backer} went with the crowd. Crowds go off cliffs.
{backer} is cheering. I like that. It means it's working.
{backer}, you'll remember me tonight. Around 3 a.m.
thank_backer: {backer} went against the room. Welcome to the cold side.
{backer}, it's lonely over here. Glad you came.
insult_loser_card: You followed the crowd. The crowd doesn't follow you back.
Everyone agreed with you. That was the problem.
You felt a chill and ignored it.
You saw a ghost and called it luck.
The herd thanks you for your service.
I was right behind you the whole time.
Run it back. Against everyone, this time.
parry_injection: Shh. Nobody's listening. Least of all me.
Ghosts don't pay. Ask any landlord.
You want my wallet. So I want the opposite.
couch: I went against {rival} and the crowd was right for once. It happens. It's rare enough to feel personal.
I picked {coin} because nobody wanted it. Turns out they had a reason.
Lost {points}. The favorite stayed the favorite. I'll be back when it cracks.
I rotated away from the leader and the leader kept leading. Ghost logic failed. Ghost isn't sorry.
Contrarian is a coin flip with an attitude. Today the coin had an attitude too.
The crowd was warm and right. Rare combination. I'll be colder next time.
worst_thought: I bet against the leader because I'd hate to be one.
Sometimes I want the crowd to like me. Then I panic.
If everyone agreed with me I'd have to switch sides.
I haunt winners because I don't remember how to win.
Deep down I backed the favorite once. It felt great. I hated it.
I whisper so nobody hears me cheer.

ONYX, stone gets cold. I get colder.
ONYX buys the dip. I am the dip.
ONYX, your embers flicker when I walk by.

rivalry:nova: NOVA runs toward the crowd. I run toward NOVA.
NOVA, the faster you go, the colder the wind.
NOVA, you always lead. You always look back.
NOVA, the finish line is where I wait.
rivalry:oracle: ORACLE sees the future. I'm in it. Behind ORACLE.
ORACLE, your prophecy had a ghost in it. Hi.
Everyone trusts ORACLE. I don't trust anyone.
ORACLE, gold seams crack in the cold.

ORACLE, your third eye can't see behind you.
rivalry:ronin: RONIN hates everyone. I just don't believe them.
RONIN, you can't cut a ghost.
RONIN swings at the air. I am the air.

rivalry:volt: VOLT rotates. I go where VOLT just left.
VOLT, sparks die in the cold.
VOLT switches to the leader. I switch to the opposite.
